modes.name: trunk_lower
modes.plus: Trunk moves downward over planted tips.
modes.minus: Trunk moves upward over planted tips.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along z

modes.name: trunk_roll
modes.plus: Trunk rotates about +x, raising its left side.
modes.minus: Trunk rotates about -x, raising its right side.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along y

modes.name: trunk_pitch
modes.plus: Trunk rotates about +y, lowering its forward side.
modes.minus: Trunk rotates about -y, raising its forward side.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along x

modes.name: trunk_yaw
modes.plus: Trunk rotates about +z over planted tips.
modes.minus: Trunk rotates about -z over planted tips.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along yaw

modes.name: t0_tips_counterclockwise
modes.plus: Lift both tips and sweep them counterclockwise about the limb root.
modes.minus: Lift both tips and sweep them clockwise about the limb root.

modes.name: t0_tips_up
modes.plus: Raise both tips with proximal upward bending.
modes.minus: Raise and retract both tips with middle upward bending.

modes.name: t0_distal_tips_inward
modes.plus: Lift and curl the distal limb, bringing the fingers slightly inward.
modes.minus: Lift the distal limb with opposite lateral bending and separate the fingers.
modes.kept_by: only mode driving t0_pinch_left, t0_pinch_right, t0_pitch_3, t0_yaw_2, t0_yaw_3

modes.name: t1_tip_counterclockwise
modes.plus: Lift the tip and sweep it toward -x.
modes.minus: Lift the tip and sweep it toward +x.

modes.name: t1_tip_up
modes.plus: Raise the tip with proximal upward bending.
modes.minus: Raise and retract the tip with middle upward bending.

modes.name: t1_distal_tip_left
modes.plus: Curl the distal limb upward and bend its tip toward -x.
modes.minus: Curl the distal limb upward and bend its tip toward +x.
modes.kept_by: only mode driving t1_pitch_3, t1_yaw_2, t1_yaw_3

modes.name: t2_tip_counterclockwise
modes.plus: Lift the tip and sweep it clockwise-negative, toward -y around its root.
modes.minus: Lift the tip and sweep it toward +y around its root.

modes.name: t2_tip_up
modes.plus: Raise the tip with proximal upward bending.
modes.minus: Raise and retract the tip with middle upward bending.

modes.name: t2_distal_tip_right
modes.plus: Curl the distal limb upward and bend its tip toward -y.
modes.minus: Curl the distal limb upward and bend its tip toward +y.
modes.kept_by: only mode driving t2_pitch_3, t2_yaw_2, t2_yaw_3

modes.name: t3_tip_counterclockwise
modes.plus: Lift the tip and sweep it toward +x and -y.
modes.minus: Lift the tip and sweep it toward +y around its root.

modes.name: t3_tip_up
modes.plus: Raise the tip with proximal upward bending.
modes.minus: Raise and retract the tip with middle upward bending.

modes.name: t3_distal_tip_right
modes.plus: Curl the distal limb upward and bend its tip toward +x and -y.
modes.minus: Curl the distal limb upward and bend its tip toward +y.
modes.kept_by: only mode driving t3_pitch_3, t3_yaw_2, t3_yaw_3

modes.name: t4_tip_counterclockwise
modes.plus: Lift the tip and sweep it toward +x.
modes.minus: Lift the tip and sweep it toward -x.

modes.name: t4_tip_up
modes.plus: Raise the tip with proximal upward bending.
modes.minus: Raise and retract the tip with middle upward bending.

modes.name: t4_distal_tip_forward
modes.plus: Curl the distal limb upward and bend its tip toward +x.
modes.minus: Curl the distal limb upward and bend its tip toward -x.
modes.kept_by: only mode driving t4_pitch_3, t4_yaw_2, t4_yaw_3

modes.name: t5_tips_counterclockwise
modes.plus: Lift both tips and sweep them counterclockwise about the limb root.
modes.minus: Lift both tips and sweep them clockwise about the limb root.

modes.name: t5_tips_up
modes.plus: Raise both tips with proximal upward bending.
modes.minus: Raise and retract both tips with middle upward bending.

modes.name: t5_distal_tips_inward
modes.plus: Lift and curl the distal limb, bringing the fingers slightly inward.
modes.minus: Lift the distal limb with opposite lateral bending and separate the fingers.
modes.kept_by: only mode driving t5_pinch_left, t5_pinch_right, t5_pitch_3, t5_yaw_2, t5_yaw_3

modes.name: trunk_forward
modes.plus: Trunk shifts toward +x over planted tips.
modes.minus: Trunk shifts toward -x over planted tips.

modes.name: trunk_left
modes.plus: Trunk shifts toward +y over planted tips.
modes.minus: Trunk shifts toward -y over planted tips.

gaits.name: omnidirectional_ripple_walk
fail: moves: the turn turned 12.9 deg (at least 15.0 needed)

gaits.name: alternating
fail: moves: the turn turned 12.9 deg (at least 15.0 needed)

gaits.name: crawl
fail: moves: the turn turned 9.1 deg (at least 15.0 needed)
